title: Tai-Khamti Phonology and Vocabulary (1977)
title_tai: သဒ္ဒါ လႄႈ သဵင် ၵႂၢမ်း တႆး ၶမ်းတီႈ
author: Dr. Alfons Weidert
provenance: Wiesbaden: Franz Steiner Verlag / Heidelberg University (Band 27) / Internet Archive (taithamtiphonolo00weid)
license: Open Access / Academic Research (Creative Commons BY-NC-ND / Fair Use)
description: Rigorous linguistic monograph on Southwestern Tai phonology and lexicography by Dr. Alfons Weidert. Provides meticulous phonetic transcriptions, tonal split analyses, vowel length distinctions, and comparative vocabulary between Tai Khamti, Tai Phake, and Tai Khamyang. Validates the conservative preservation of Proto-Southwestern Tai initial consonants and the five/six-tone phonemic register in Upper Assam.
